text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday. I got the nail stickers 
you asked for as a present."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! I've been waiting for this! Big 
thanks~!! Anything City picks out is 
totally fire!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I picked out a pattern you'd like. 
Still, stickers these days are really high 
quality, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! You just stick it on, it's super 
convenient~! And you can customize it on 
top♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Best of all, you can just peel it off 
without filing it down like gel! Not 
damaging your nails is seriously the best.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's nice that it comes off easily. It's 
tough to do gel nails when you have photo 
shoots, after all...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah—, right! City, you mentioned that 
before~. That you can't really do fancy 
nails in your private time~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Let's use the stickers you got 
for your birthday right away! I'll stick 
'em on real nice for ya~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I guess so, but... It's a present for you, 
you know...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it belongs to me, right? So I can use 
it however I want, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh... What is that? That's seriously 
hilarious.
